videos.title: Charcoal drawing time-lapse of "Ozee" the pit bull puppy
videos.description:
Hello, and welcome to my YouTube channel. My name is Rick Berube. I am a self-taught artist. I have a passion for painting landscapes, and seascapes in oils and I also love to draw portraits of people and animals. I have dabbled in different mediums including charcoal, graphite and colored pencils and miscellaneous mixed media. I have recently started painting using other mediums such as watercolors and acrylics as well. It's a constant learning experience for me and I am extremely grateful for other You-Tubers that have helped me along the way. I can only hope that maybe one day I can help another artist with some technique that I have learned here. I always say "pay it forward". I hope you enjoy my videos.

Please visit my website to view my gallery of recent and past drawings and paintings that I have for sale at 

http://rjbartstudio.com

videos.title: Drawing of Midnight the cat
videos.description:
I drew this using mostly Derwent graphite pencils and General's charcoal pencils. I had a hard time since I decided to try a charcoal specific paper from Strathmore but I didn't like the results since it left multiple lines that were very hard to blend away. I guess I am not used to this paper and I don't think I will be using it again any time soon. All in all this took some getting used to. I am somewhat happy with the final results.
